pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by the PEDIA Tape.
Focus on rapid and early BLS airway and ventilation tools. Intubation may not be the best
Pediatric pads should be used in children < 10 Kg or PEDIA tape color purple.
Ventricular tachycardia on ECG (runs or sustained)
Rate usually 150-180 bpm for sustained V-tach

pl1: 4 lead and 12 lead ECG placement and acquisition
pl2: Isotonic Crystalloid PRN titrated to SBP > 90 mmHg or MAP > 65
pl3: If a Treatable cause is identified, move that treatment up in priority
If Torsades de Pointes: Magnesium Sulfate
If Torsades de Pointes: Defibrillate at maximum joules for Adult
If VT is refractory Amiodarone, then Lidocaine
If hyperkalemia or Tricyclic OD, consider Sodium Bicarbonate early
Synchronize cardioversion at maximum Joules for Adult
For Pediatric Cardioversion 0.5 – 1.0 j/kg, repeat at 2 j/kg as needed
